data.one_liner: Full-featured XML and XPath library for DOM parsing, SAX streaming, and fluent building.
data.what_it_does: Dart XML provides tools for parsing, traversing, querying via XPath 3.1, and building XML documents. It supports both in-memory DOM manipulation and memory-efficient event-driven SAX streaming.
use_when: You need to parse, query, or manipulate XML documents in Dart or Flutter.
You require XPath 3.1 support for complex document queries.
You need to process large XML streams efficiently without buffering the entire tree.
avoid_when: You need strict XML Schema (XSD) validation built directly into the parser.
You require full XSLT transformations or complex XQuery modules.
strengths: Comprehensive W3C XPath 3.1 implementation and DOM model.
Supports both pull- and push-based event-driven SAX streaming.
Zero overhead and fully portable across Dart VM, Flutter, and Web.
weaknesses: Does not validate documents against XML Schema (XSD) definitions.
External DTD entity resolution and validation are not enforced.
